title: axm-community-lab/host-observation-receipt@1
description: Body-free return receipt for one host observation. It binds the identity and digests of an observation so a join can be recorded in the open while the observed body stays on the host that produced it. Issue #151 requires the N01 result to return as a body-contained observation plus this receipt for the W01 join. The receipt carries no hostname, device name, model, capacity, path, kernel string, or accelerator identifier: the only observation-body values it may repeat are the declared join coordinates listed in body_free_join_coordinates, and the collector and Python executable digests.

host_id.description: The declared Estate role the observation was collected under. A role label, never a host name.

observation_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical observation body, excluding the digest field itself.

observation_file_name.description: Basename of the published observation, always <host-id>.json.

observation_file_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact published file bytes, which is not the same value as observation_sha256.

host_fingerprint_sha256.description: Body-safe observed-host fingerprint. Distinct fingerprints are what prove three machines rather than three labels; the digest publishes none of its inputs.

accelerator_identity_sha256.description: SHA-256 of each accelerator identity, so cross-host duplication is checkable without publishing any accelerator identifier.

seed_id.description: SHA-256 of the exact bytes of seed/sha256sums.txt: the identity of the bundle that produced this receipt.

receipt_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical receipt body, excluding this field.
